items.title: Bring Your Squad Back From the Brink
items.body: All hope is not lost when a teammate goes down! When they fall, they leave behind a Reboot Card. Pick it up, take it to a Reboot Van, and bring them back into the fight for a better shot at victory.

items.title: Rarer Color, Better Weapons!
items.body: Weapons come in five rarities: Gray (Common), Green (Uncommon), Blue (Rare), Purple (Epic), and Orange (Legendary). Higher rarity means better stats, so open Chests and swap out weapons when finding something better!

items.title: The Horror Is Here
items.body: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches. Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await, including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Gameplay
items.body: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor. Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.

items.title: Treasure Hunters - November 1
items.body: Chests to crack. Sprites to extract. Treasure to claim. The greatest treasure hunt of all time lands on November 1.
